pages.text: Base cost: 35. Cooldown: 10s. 6 blocks, normally up to 5 seconds; shorter on large targets.
Hold R to select. Tap G for slot 1 or hold G for about 0.4 seconds for slot 2. Alternate forms add 4 concentration; each cost upgrade saves 2. Signs are disabled in official bouts.
Mass confusion: Calm several hostile mobs in a wide cone.
Domination: Turn one hostile mob against another.
Redirect aggression: Redirect several hostile mobs toward other enemies.
